Tom Reyes: Hi all — first day! Quick question: where do you post laptop/setup issues vs product questions vs general FYIs? Also how do people mute the noisy deploy/builder bots without missing real alerts?

Lena Cho: Welcome Tom :wave: Setup/access -> #help (include: name/team/resource/urgency). Infra/deploy -> #eng-infra. Product questions -> #product. Small FYIs -> thread in your team channel so the main channel stays clean.

Priya S.: Bot noise: don't mute channels globally. Instead open channel > Integrations > find the app and change notification settings (e.g., "only on failures"). Also add notification keywords like your name or "pager".

InfraBot: If you need infra access, post in #eng-infra with this template: "Name / Team / Resource (e.g., deploy role, VPN) / Error message / Urgency". Include command output if it's a CLI failure.

OnboardBot: Hi Tom! For onboarding resources: https://intranet.redwood/onboard. To get a buddy DM me "assign buddy" or run `/onboard subscribe-digest` to receive a short daily digest.

Tom Reyes: Thanks — super helpful. One more: reactions vs replies? When should I just react instead of replying?

Lena Cho: React for ack/thanks. Reply when you need follow-up or an action item. Keeps channels scannable.

Priya S.: Also pin common how-tos in the channel so new threads don't bury them.

Tom Reyes: Got it, thanks everyone!
